prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the four-frame blink cycle of the crate drop crate: a square ammunition crate.

Design identity to keep exactly — Green speed crate: green rim (#38c838), body (#14501a dim / #4aa84a lit). A squat square supply crate, lid seam across the upper third, rim-coloured corner braces on all four corners, bold near-black outline, hard top-left pixel shading. Its face glyph is a bold white right-pointing chevron stencil (a single fast-forward arrow). The crate stays IDENTICAL in silhouette and position across all four cells; only the body brightness blinks.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 square cells laid out as 2 ROWS OF 2 (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = frame 1 dim — crate body dark, glyph lit The subject lies within aspect 0.72:1 to 1.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 2 = frame 2 dim — body dark, glyph lit (a hair brighter corner lamps) The subject lies within aspect 0.72:1 to 1.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 3 = frame 3 bright — body lit through, glyph kept The subject lies within aspect 0.72:1 to 1.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
  cell 4 = frame 4 bright — body lit, corner braces flaring The subject lies within aspect 0.72:1 to 1.4:1, identical scale and position as the other cells — only the named state changes.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
